app.title: Ggml v1.0.0
app.description: Lightweight, header‑only C/C++ library for tensor operations optimized for inference workloads, used by many LLM inference projects.
proposed_tests: build the library with CMake on Linux
compile a sample program that creates a 4‑dim tensor and performs a matmul
measure execution time for 1,000,000 random matmuls and compare to pure CPU implementation
run the provided Python example to load a small model and perform inference
